project.title: Non-Archimedean Bedford–Taylor theory
project.subtitle: Intrinsic calculus · Positive currents · Pluripotential theory
project.summary: A systematic programme for intrinsic differential operations, positive currents and pluripotential theory on Berkovich spaces.
project.motivation: Differential and intersection operations on non-Archimedean spaces should be compatible with geometric objects and independent of their chosen presentations. The project aims to organize local constructions, their compatibility, and their applications into a coherent theory.
project.programme:
## Intrinsic differential operations
Describe the objects, admissible potentials and relations on which the operations are defined.

## Products and continuity
Study well-defined products, locality, positivity and convergence under explicitly stated assumptions.

## Capacity and equations
Develop the interfaces with capacities, energy classes and Monge–Ampère problems.

## A unified exposition
Assemble the definitions, proofs and open problems into a systematic monograph.
